review_evidence: README describes Leanwuzla as a development frontend for sending bv_decide-generated problems to Bitwuzla and explicitly says it is not intended for productive use and its SMT reduction is not necessarily sound.

A complete proposition-declaration scan of Leanwuzla/ finds zero theorem, lemma, example, or axiom declarations; production modules implement SMT-LIB/S-expression parsing, solver invocation, tactic plumbing, and comparative timing.

The proposition declarations are confined to Test/Bitwuzla.lean and Test/BVCompare.lean and serve solver/tactic regression comparisons over small bit-vector examples rather than an independent verified theory.

source_action.content_invariant: Production modules contain no proposition declarations and implement parser/solver/tactic plumbing; all checked propositions are small regression inputs under Test/, while the README explicitly disclaims soundness of the reduction, so retirement removes no independent formal specification or proof development.
